metadata.description: XRPL plugin marketplace — three modular plugins for XRP Ledger: HTTP cloud client, local stdio server, and offline wallet signer. Source code, binaries and manifests live atomically in this repo.

plugins.name: xrpl-cloud
plugins.description: Lightweight HTTP MCP that proxies to the StaticBit cloud server at xrpl.mcp.staticbit.ai. Read/prepare/submit XRPL transactions without running anything locally. OAuth 2.1 auth (run /mcp to log in). ~10 KB.

plugins.name: xrpl-signer
plugins.description: Offline stdio MCP for XRPL wallet management and transaction signing. Encrypted keystore (PBKDF2 + AES-256-GCM), per-wallet salt/IV. Zero network code path — pure crypto. Pairs with xrpl-cloud for the prepare/submit half of the flow.
